allow:
Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
feat: initialize AI native workflow project with UUID support

- Add comprehensive README documenting AI collaboration friction points
  and three-pillar AI native workflow framework (executable specs,
  persistent context, orchestratable actions)
- Initialize Go module with google/uuid dependency for unique ID generation
- Add basic hello.go example demonstrating UUID functionality
- Include standard .gitignore for Go projects

This establishes the foundation for an AI-native development workflow
with proper tooling and documentation structure.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)")

hooks.command: FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case $FILE in *.go) gofmt -w $FILE 2>&1 && goimports -w $FILE 2>&1 && jq -n --arg f "$FILE" '{message: ("Formatted: " + $f)}' ;; *) jq -n '{}' ;;
